list.title: Agents
list.subtitle: List of A2A-spec agents that are available to be used in your organization. Go to AI Hub, to make agents public.

alert.title: Why do agents need keys?
alert.description: Keys scope access to an agent and allow it to call MCP tools. Assign a key when creating an agent or from the Virtual Keys page.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Agent
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete agent: {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.

search.placeholder: Search agents by name, ID, or description...

healthCheck.label: Health Check
healthCheck.tooltip: When enabled, only agents with reachable URLs are shown

none.title: No agents yet
none.description: Add an agent to make it available in your organization.

noMatch.title: No matching agents
noMatch.description: Adjust the search to see more agents.

mcp.allowedServersHint: Select which MCP servers or access groups this agent can access. Keys bound to this agent can only reach servers granted here.
mcp.selectPlaceholder: Select MCP servers or access groups (optional)

settings.title: Agent Settings
settings.hint: Click "Edit Settings" to modify agent configuration.

keys.title: Virtual Keys
keys.empty: No virtual key assigned to this agent.

agentType.customHint: For agents that don't follow a standard protocol, just needs a virtual key

validation.uniqueAgentName: Please enter a unique agent name

form.descriptionHint: Brief description of what this agent does

basic.urlTooltip: Base URL where the agent is hosted (optional)
basic.protocolVersionTooltip: The A2A protocol version LiteLLM serves to clients for this agent. LiteLLM converts the upstream agent's responses to this version, so clients always see the version you pick here regardless of the original agent's version.
basic.protocolVersionHelp: LiteLLM serves this version to clients and converts the upstream agent's responses to match it, regardless of the original agent's version.

skillFields.name: Skill Name
skillFields.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
skillFields.examplesPlaceholder: Type an example and press Enter

authHeaders.staticHeadersHint: Headers always sent to the backend agent, regardless of the client request. Admin-configured, static wins on conflict.
authHeaders.forwardClientHeadersHint: Header names to extract from the client's request and forward to the agent. Type a name and press Enter.

configure.agentTypeHint: Select the type of agent you want to create

entitlements.description: Configure which models, agents, and MCP tools this agent is allowed to use. Leave fields empty to allow all (subject to key/team permissions).
entitlements.allowedModelsHint: Restrict which models this agent can call. Leave empty to allow all.
entitlements.allowedAgentsHint: Restrict which other agents this agent can invoke as sub-agents. Leave empty to allow all.
entitlements.allowedMcpServersHint: Select which MCP servers or access groups this agent can access

observability.requireInbound: Require x-litellm-trace-id on calls TO this agent
observability.requireInboundHint: Only accept this agent being invoked with a trace-id (e.g. when used as a sub-agent).
observability.requireOutbound: Require x-litellm-trace-id on calls BY this agent
observability.requireOutboundHint: Requires LLM/MCP calls made by this agent to include x-litellm-trace-id for session tracking.
observability.budgetsHint: Enable "Require x-litellm-trace-id on calls BY this agent" in Tracing to configure budgets and rate limits.
observability.maxIterationsHint: Hard cap on LLM calls per session
observability.maxBudgetHint: Max spend per trace before returning 429
observability.agentRateLimitsHint: Global rate limits applied across all callers of this agent.
observability.perSessionRateLimitsHint: Rate limits per session (x-litellm-trace-id). Each session gets its own counters.
observability.guardrailsHint: Apply guardrails to this agent. Selected guardrails will run on all calls made by this agent.

assignKey.teamHint: Optionally assign this agent to a team. The agent and its key will belong to the selected team.
assignKey.createNew: Create a new key for this agent
assignKey.createNewHint: A dedicated key scoped to this agent.
assignKey.assignExistingHint: Re-assign a key you already have to this agent.
assignKey.skip: Skip for now — I'll assign a key later

ready.noKey: No key assigned. You can create one from the Virtual Keys page.
